Construct Name: Evaluation of open educational resources (application, content, design, value)
Context Text: Teachers' evaluations of the DIALLS project's open educational resources -- professional-development materials on cultural literacy, on dialogue and argumentation and on mediating wordless films; the DIALLS lesson plans; the Scale of Progression for Cultural Literacy Learning; and the project's discussion forum as a community of practice. Three study-authored items each on a resource's application, content, design and value, after Kirkpatrick & Kirkpatrick's (2006) evaluation model, plus motivation/participation/topic/value facets for the forum (Wenger et al. 2011). Five-point agreement scale, Strongly disagree (1) to Strongly agree (5).
Notes: 138 teachers from the UK (UCAM), Portugal (NOVA), Israel (HUJI) and Germany (UBER), September 2020 to February 2021; H2020 DIALLS WP4 deliverable 4.1 (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.5553923, CC BY 4.0). One crossed table of 79 items rather than four tables: the same instrument, the same scale and the same teachers across the four surveys, linked by a respondent-generated code. The missingness is by design -- not all teachers answered all four surveys. Item text shipped from the SPSS variable and value labels; it is the project's English master, so for the three non-English partners it is a stand-in for what was administered.
